query: What is the current status of SpaceX Starship Flight 13 (IFT-13) as of mid-July 2026? Has Booster 20 completed its static fire test? Has the FAA approved Flight 13 / accepted the Flight 12 mishap investigation? What is the latest NET (no earlier than) launch date shown on trackers like NextSpaceflight and RGV Aerial Photography?
answer:
I've completed the research on SpaceX Starship Flight 13 (IFT-13). Here's the summary of findings as of mid-July 2026:

## Key Answers to Your Questions

**Current Status:** Flight 13 is fully cleared and on track for launch **NET Thursday, July 16, 2026** from Starbase, Texas — the 13th integrated test and 2nd flight of Starship V3.

**Booster 20 static fire — YES, COMPLETED:** On **July 10, 2026**, Booster 20 ignited all **33 Raptor engines** for a record **~24–25 seconds** — the longest Super Heavy static fire ever. It has since been rolled back for final checkouts (reported July 14) before stacking with Ship 40. (Ship 40 completed its own ~60-second static fire on July 1.)

**FAA approval / Flight 12 mishap investigation — YES, CLOSED:** On **Monday, July 13, 2026**, the FAA closed its investigation into the Flight 12 booster return-failure anomaly (from the May 22, 2026 flight), accepted SpaceX's findings and corrective actions, found no public injuries/property damage, and cleared Flight 13 to proceed.

**Latest NET date on trackers:**
- **NextSpaceflight:** Liftoff July 16, 2026 at 22:45 GMT (window 22:45–00:15 GMT)
- **SpaceX/local (RGV/KRGV):** 90-min window opening 5:45 p.m. Central / 6:45 p.m. EDT, July 16, with Highway 4 and Boca Chica Beach closures scheduled

**Mission note:** Flight 13 will attempt the first deployment of 20 functional Starlink V3 satellites, with the booster targeting an offshore Gulf landing burn.

All facts were cross-validated across NextSpaceflight, NASASpaceflight, SpaceNews, CNBC, Space.com, KRGV, and spacepolicyonline.
